BEGIN;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'task' AND column_name = 'task_kind'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task RENAME COLUMN task_kind TO task_kind_legacy';
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'task' AND column_name = 'type'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN "type" smallint';
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'task' AND column_name = 'task_kind_legacy'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            UPDATE task
            SET "type" = CASE LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(task_kind_legacy, '')))
                WHEN 'frontend_preview' THEN 1
                WHEN 'fullstack_page' THEN 2
                WHEN 'cli_programming' THEN 3
                WHEN 'api_endpoint' THEN 4
                WHEN 'debug_fix' THEN 5
                WHEN 'refactor_quality' THEN 6
                WHEN 'git_cli' THEN 7
                WHEN 'sql_query' THEN 8
                WHEN 'quiz_theory' THEN 9
                WHEN 'project_milestone' THEN 10
                ELSE 1
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN "type" SET DEFAULT 1;

UPDATE task
SET "type" = COALESCE("type", 1);

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN "type" SET NOT NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'execution_mode'
          AND data_type IN ('character varying', 'text')
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN execution_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN execution_mode TYPE smallint
            USING CASE UPPER(BTRIM(execution_mode))
                WHEN 'BROWSER_PREVIEW' THEN 1
                WHEN 'TERMINAL_RUN' THEN 2
                WHEN 'HTTP_API' THEN 3
                WHEN 'NO_RUN' THEN 4
                ELSE 1
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'evaluation_mode'
          AND data_type IN ('character varying', 'text')
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode TYPE smallint
            USING CASE UPPER(BTRIM(evaluation_mode))
                WHEN 'AUTO' THEN 1
                WHEN 'MANUAL' THEN 2
                WHEN 'HYBRID' THEN 3
                ELSE 1
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
          AND table_name = 'task'
          AND column_name = 'ui_mode'
          AND data_type IN ('character varying', 'text')
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE 'ALTER TABLE task ALTER COLUMN ui_mode DROP DEFAULT';
        EXECUTE $sql$
            ALTER TABLE task
            ALTER COLUMN ui_mode TYPE smallint
            USING CASE UPPER(BTRIM(ui_mode))
                WHEN 'PREVIEW' THEN 1
                WHEN 'TERMINAL' THEN 2
                WHEN 'REPORT' THEN 3
                WHEN 'QUIZ' THEN 4
                ELSE 1
            END
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

UPDATE task
SET
    execution_mode = COALESCE(execution_mode, 1),
    evaluation_mode = COALESCE(evaluation_mode, 1),
    ui_mode = COALESCE(ui_mode, 1);

ALTER TABLE task
    ALTER COLUMN execution_mode SET DEFAULT 1,
    ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode SET DEFAULT 1,
    ALTER COLUMN ui_mode SET DEFAULT 1,
    ALTER COLUMN execution_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN evaluation_mode SET NOT NULL,
    ALTER COLUMN ui_mode SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE task
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS task_kind_legacy;

COMMIT;
